text:
Priya: Proposing an evening oncall handoff tomorrow 18:30 PST (21:30 EST). Short agenda: 1) review open incidents (INC-1234, INC-1247), 2) confirm primary/secondary escalation matrix, 3) quick RFC review for autoscaler tweak (docs: https://redwood.dev/rfcs/autoscale), 4) pending deploys & KV cache handoff. Who can make it? @Marco @Jules @Talia :calendar:
Marco: I can attend but will be ~5m late. I can take primary for DB/latency incidents if needed.
Jules: I end my shift at 19:00 so can stay until ~18:45. Happy to be infra secondary. Can we call out any ongoing rollouts that need extra attention?
Talia: I’ll join and cover alert routing + pager duty. I’ll post the alerts runbook in thread shortly.
Priya: Thanks. Current rollouts: frontend-canary (low risk), batch-scheduler (deploy queued). Add 'pending deploys' to agenda so we explicitly hand off the queue.
Talia: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/alerts (link). Also adding note: if INC-1247 escalates, we should page security on-call. Anyone object?
Marco: No objections. If it's data-impacting, escalate to Security. I’ll be primary for DB pages; Jules is infra backup.
Jules: Ack. Can someone add a 2-line status for INC-1234 before the meeting? I’ll bring logs if needed: ```logs tail -n 200 /var/log/serving/error.log``` 
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC — may impact scheduled jobs. :robot_face:
Priya: Good catch. I’ll publish a short meeting note doc and post the bridge link 10m before start. Bridge: https://zoom.redwood/hand-off-1854321123. Meeting notes doc: https://docs.redwood/notes/oncall-handoff-1854321123
Talia: I’ll ping sec on-call if we hit data indicators. Otherwise see you all 18:30 PST. :thumbsup:
Priya: Perfect — final checklist for attendees: - quick summary of your current open incidents - confirm primary/secondary - note any blocked deploys - handover KV cache state if applicable. See you then.
